officeIntegration.serviceManaged: Developers manages this organization’s Office connection. You cannot change the Office address or credentials on this page.
officeIntegration.description: Choose this organization’s Office connection and save the settings.
officeIntegration.ticketHelp: Drive requests a one-use ticket from TFO and returns the document URL. A ticket service token is required.
officeIntegration.legacyHelp: Drive creates a document URL using the legacy method. Legacy authentication must also be enabled on TFO. Saving this mode clears the ticket service token from Drive. File access and saving still use the HTTP Storage signing key.
officeIntegration.addressHelp: Enter a TFO address reachable by both the user’s browser and the Drive server. Example: https://office.example.com
officeIntegration.tokenHelp: Ask the TFO server operator for TFO_DOCUMENT_OPEN_TICKET_ISSUE_SERVICE_TOKEN and enter its value here. Ticket authentication must also be enabled on TFO.
officeIntegration.adapterHelp: Enter the same name as the HTTP Storage adapter in TFO. Use letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. Different names prevent documents from opening or saving.
officeIntegration.signingKeyHelp: In TFO, generate a secure secret and copy it here. For an existing adapter, use its current secret. We recommend at least 32 ASCII letters or digits. TFO does not allow changing a registered adapter’s secret.
officeIntegration.loadFailed: Could not load Office settings. Refresh the page to try again.
officeIntegration.noneHelp: After saving, Drive hides Office open, edit and new-document actions. Users can view file information or download Office documents like other files. Drive keeps the existing connection settings. Documents already open can still be saved while their sessions and permissions remain valid.
officeIntegration.onPremiseChoice: Open and edit documents on your organization’s TFO server.
officeIntegration.cloudChoice: Connection using an API Key is coming soon.
officeIntegration.noneChoice: Manage Office documents in the same way as other files.
officeIntegration.detailsHelp: Configure how your on-premise TFO server opens documents and connects to Drive.
officeIntegration.storageSection: 2. Storage settings shared by TFO and Drive
officeIntegration.adapterInstructions: Sign in to TFO administration. Open External integration → Add adapter and choose HTTP Storage. Use the same adapter name and signing key shown below in TFO.
officeIntegration.endpointTitle: What goes in TFO’s Provider Base URL?
officeIntegration.endpointHelp: Enter the Drive tenant’s backend address followed by /api/v1. For a tenant at https://drive.example.com/t/acme, the Provider Base URL is https://drive.example.com/t/acme/api/v1. Keep /t/acme: it identifies the tenant that receives the request. TFO appends /tfo-http-storage/v1 and the operation path automatically; do not add them here. For installations without a tenant path, enter https://drive.example.com/api/v1. The TFO server must be able to reach this address.
officeIntegration.applyTitle: 3. Save the settings and verify the connection
officeIntegration.applySave: The Drive administrator clicks Save on this page. Drive saves the settings but does not register the TFO adapter automatically.
officeIntegration.applyTest: The TFO administrator runs Connection test in Add adapter. Drive does not return files to this initial test without a user document session. If TFO reports that listing is unsupported, review and acknowledge the notice to register the adapter.
officeIntegration.applyOpen: The TFO administrator checks that the adapter is running. A Drive user then opens a document to verify the connection. Drive supplies user and document-session metadata; you do not need to enter it in TFO’s additional parameters.
officeIntegration.managedAdapterHelp: Developers uses the Storage ID as the adapter name. Developers manages this value; you cannot change it here.
officeIntegration.adapterChangeWarning: Saving changes the adapter name immediately. Save and close open documents before changing the name in both Drive and TFO. Documents using the previous name may fail to save.
